name: edgaralert-mcp
description: Ask Claude live questions about SEC insider trading signals, Form 4 activity, 8-K officer/director changes, and company research context.
long_description: Connects Claude to your EDGAR Alert account via the official, read-only EDGAR Alert v1 API. Search and explore insider trading alerts, company profiles, fundamentals, and AI-ready company research context directly in conversation. Most tools work on any paid EDGAR Alert plan; the bundled AI research-context tool requires Enterprise. Your API key is stored securely by Claude Desktop and is never written to disk by this extension.

api_key.title: EDGAR Alert API Key
api_key.description: Your EDGAR Alert API key (find it at edgaralert.com/account/api-keys). Most tools work on any paid plan; the AI research-context tool requires Enterprise and will show a clear upgrade message if your plan doesn't include it.

tools.name: edgaralert_get_latest_alerts
tools.description: Returns the most recent insider trading alerts.

tools.name: edgaralert_search_alerts
tools.description: Searches insider trading alerts with detailed filters.

tools.name: edgaralert_get_alert_price_window
tools.description: Returns price performance around a specific alert.

tools.name: edgaralert_search_companies
tools.description: Searches companies by name, ticker, sector, or other criteria.

tools.name: edgaralert_get_company_profile
tools.description: Returns a company profile with market, fundamentals, and insider summary.

tools.name: edgaralert_get_company_agent_context
tools.description: Returns AI-ready bundled company research context (Enterprise).

tools.name: edgaralert_get_weekly_insights
tools.description: Returns a market-wide weekly insider trading summary.
